ddl: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS sales_invoices_tenant_due_idx ON sales_invoices (tenant_id, due_date)
why: enum_eq is not leakproof, so `status` cannot become an index condition under RLS; `due_date` can
reason: used by the planner and removed 96% of median time

ddl: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS audit_logs_tenant_keyset_idx ON audit_logs (tenant_id, created_at DESC, id DESC)
why: the keyset cursor orders by (created_at DESC, id DESC) and no index carries the tiebreak
reason: used by the planner and removed 33% of median time

ddl: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS journal_entries_trial_balance_cover ON journal_entries (tenant_id, ledger_id, entry_type) INCLUDE (amount_minor)
why: an index-only scan would avoid the 6,800-page heap scan the trial balance does today
reason: the planner did not choose it — an index that never appears in a plan is write cost only

ddl: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS stock_movements_balance_cover ON stock_movements (tenant_id, stock_item_id, warehouse_id) INCLUDE (quantity)
why: on-hand balance reads only three key columns plus quantity; the heap visit is pure waste
reason: the planner did not choose it — an index that never appears in a plan is write cost only

ddl: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS change_log_tenant_changed_at_idx ON change_log (tenant_id, changed_at)
why: prune_change_log() scans the whole table once per tenant and no index leads with tenant_id
reason: used by the planner and removed 84% of median time

ddl: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS campaign_recipients_tenant_idx ON campaign_recipients (tenant_id, campaign_id)
why: all three existing indexes lead with campaign_id; the RLS predicate is on tenant_id
reason: used, but removed only -5% of median time and 28% of buffers

ddl: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS contacts_tenant_live_idx ON contacts (tenant_id, created_at) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
why: every contact list and every export filters `deleted_at IS NULL` and no index carries it
reason: used by the planner and removed 52% of median time
